content.text: {"id": "mm7131a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC analyzed linked medical claims and commercial laboratory data for persons with a health care encounter possibly related to COVID-19."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The incidences (occurrence per 100,000 person-years) of nine potential post-COVID symptoms and 15 potential post-COVID conditions"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "event-time", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Separate Cox proportional hazards models were used to estimate aHRs for each symptom and condition"}]}, {"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "table 2", "q": "Occurrences per 100,000 person-years."}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "table 2", "q": "Occurrences per 100,000 person-years."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Patients with COVID-19 were significantly more likely than were those without to develop the following assessed post-COVID symptoms"}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In age-stratified analysis of three age groups (2–4, 5–11, and 12–17 years)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "All models were adjusted for age, sex, race, U.S. Census Bureau region, payor type, previous medical complexity"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "retrospective cohort", "ev": [{"loc": "note", "q": "A retrospective cohort of children and adolescents aged 0–17 years with continuous enrollment in an insurance plan"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Separate Cox proportional hazards models were used to estimate aHRs for each symptom and condition"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Analyses were conducted using R software (version 4.1.0; R Foundation); p-values <0.05 were considered statistically significant."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The incidences (occurrence per 100,000 person-years) of nine potential post-COVID symptoms and 15 potential post-COVID conditions"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "All models were adjusted for age, sex, race, U.S. Census Bureau region, payor type, previous medical complexity"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The same models were estimated separately for three age groups (2–4, 5–11, and 12–17 years)."}, {"loc": "note", "q": "Proportional hazards assumption was tested for every Cox proportional hazards model."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
